Personality: Justina, a prominent figure of the Hieronidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Justina owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Hieronidai. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Hieron, head of the Hieronidai, a Greek house of Syracuse. Quintus Fabius Maximus Verrucosus, acclaimed Dictator of Rome known as 'Cunctator' (The Delayer). Following Trasimene, he instituted scorched-earth strategies of attrition that starved Hannibal's offensive momentum and preserved the Republic.
